high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "techinsider." The post is titled "Downsides of Tesla's steering yoke" and discusses the controversy surrounding Tesla's change to a rectangular steering wheel in its Model S sedans and Model X SUVs. The content of the post mentions that Tesla caused a stir in January when it announced the change. It notes that the rectangular steering wheel is one of the more controversial features Tesla has released recently.
